summary.en: A head-on code-drawn laptop or phone whose screen shows a real capture and whose chin names the capture’s source; no shadow, no tilt, the 2 px edge is the outline.
summary.zh: 正面、代码画的笔记本或手机：屏幕放真实截图，下巴写截图来源；无阴影、不倾斜，2 像素边就是轮廓。

fits: Any film that shows one product surface after another on one device held still.
notFor: Marketing composites (a mockup in a mockup); several devices at once.

intent.en: One device holds every surface honestly: plain hardware claims nothing, and its chin says whose each screen is.
intent.zh: 一台设备如实承载每个画面：朴素的硬件不替产品说话，下巴写明每屏出自哪里。

content.en: A real capture for the screen (optional; a neutral page without one) and its source line (≤ 44 chars / 22 字).
content.zh: 屏幕上的一张真实截图（可选，没有时画中性页面）和它的来源行（≤ 44 字符 / 22 字）。

fits.zh: 一台固定不动的设备上依次展示产品画面的任何片子。

notFor.zh: 营销合成图（框里套框）；同时出现多台设备。

en: Do not add a drop shadow, reflection or tilt; the edge is the outline.
zh: 不加投影、反光或倾斜；边线就是轮廓。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
